page.overview:
Who is Adi'son?

Adi'son was a Twi'lek male who worked as a stimulant vendor on the planet Tython during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. the Twi'lek was operating a stall selling stimulants and medpacs in the training grounds of the Jedi Order in the Tythonian Gnarls region of the world while the Jedi fought an uprising of the local Flesh Raider species there. Adi'son had green eyes, yellow-green skin, and spoke language other than Galactic Basic Standard. The merchant wore a dark gray shirt with light gray pants and boots while at their stall.

Adi'son appears in BioWare's 2011 massively multiplayer online role-playing game, Star Wars: The Old Republic.
